entry.title: Morpho-PE 1.0.2
entry.summary: Rebuilt against the updated mpc-vst-plugins wrapper: **Q-Links now move parameters on track edit → automation** (a plain host write no longer makes MPC rebuild its parameter screen; sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins#486). No other changes. `*-mpc-armv7.zip` is for Gen1 MPCs and the Force; `*-mpc-aarch64.zip` is the Gen2 build (MPC OS 3.x), tested offline only. Settings and your own files in the plugin's data folders are kept on upgrade.

entry.title: Morpho-PE 1.0.1
entry.summary: # Morpho-PE 1.0.1 Playtest fixes: - The cutoff, resonance, distortion, volume, audio mod and feedback-level knobs are smoothed, so turning them no longer steps audibly. - Distortion keeps the instrument's gain table and hard clip, with an output level makeup so a small turn of the knob no longer jumps in loudness. - Output hack works on the right scale: the top settings now crush the sound instead of going near-silent (and no DC offset). - Digital waves: formant waves 4-23 are two-peak vowels an

entry.title: Morpho-PE 1.0.0
entry.summary: # Morpho-PE 1.0.0 A four-voice synthesizer for Akai MPC OS 3.x standalone devices, modelled on the DSI Poly Evolver's voice: two analog-style and two digital waveshape oscillators per voice, a stereo 2/4-pole lowpass, delay, tuned feedback, distortion, three envelopes, four LFOs, modulation slots and the 4 x 16 step sequencer, with a touchscreen skin, Q-Link pages and a bank browser. Poly Evolver / Evolver program dumps load as they are. Independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Da
